root_cause.statement: Daily ranking still accepts a generic pilot-to-metric binding without requiring a pre-existing immutable denominator event and proof that the implementation can transition that exact event into the metric numerator. Pilot-local benchmark success therefore reaches production and predictably re-reads at zero portfolio-metric effect.

live_completion_actual_effect.common_reason: The bounded capability changed only its pilot-local evidence and did not add or reclassify a completed item in the immutable live-completion ledger.

smallest_safe_corrective_action: Before assigning any Trends task, require a stable immutable denominator_event_id already present in the selected metric ledger.
Name the exact current event state, the target numerator transition, the canonical product or operational route and why the implementation can cause that transition under the unchanged formula.
Reject pilot-local benchmark improvements as metric eligibility when they cannot modify the canonical ledger event.
If no causally compatible metric event exists, emit NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC, keep the task READY and do not create implementation, terminalization or deployment PRs.

expected_effect.process: Stop predictable zero-effect pilot churn before implementation and reserve capacity for a ledger-eligible outcome.
expected_effect.raw_target: The next accepted live-completion assignment is capable of moving the unchanged raw input from 1/4 to 2/4.
expected_effect.measurement: Compare the next accepted assignment cohort with the current 0/25 gain baseline and re-read the exact immutable metric after canonical production verification.
expected_effect.credit_policy: No score, completion or product credit until canonical ACTUAL_EFFECT proves the raw change.

acceptance: eligibility evidence names current event state and exact numerator transition
task has a canonical project, repo, branch and production route capable of producing that transition
ranking returns NO_COMPATIBLE_METRIC without consuming a slot when causality is absent
PR Delivery Sweep owns GitHub delivery and Evening Delivery Closure owns the terminal receipt
terminal receipt re-reads the same unchanged-formula metric
zero delta remains EVALUATED_NO_EFFECT with zero credit
